snippet.title: Heirs of the Moon - Official Playtest Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Playtest Launch Trailer for Heirs of the Moon, a third-person open-world nature game developed by Redwater. Players will roam the lands as an apex predator on a survival adventure. Raise a pack of your own, hunt animals, and continue the bloodline by any means necessary. Heirs of the Moon is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Playtest available now on Steam.
